# Version 4.150.2
> **m150 servicing update** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.2/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.2 refreshes the m150 release line with upstream Ganesh and Chrome bug fixes. This servicing release is narrowly focused on bundled-engine maintenance, keeping the 4.150 line current without changing the managed API surface or introducing new migration work.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **The m150 branch picked up another round of upstream fixes** — SkiaSharp 4.150.2 rolls in multiple Chrome m150 bug-fix merges together with additional Ganesh fixes, keeping the packaged renderer current for consumers staying on the 4.150 servicing line. ([#4517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4517), [#4561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4561), [#4648](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4648), [#4663](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4663))

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
